g.text: R18=10K to VAMP; Q4 pulls SD_MODE low.

g.desc: R18=10K to VAMP; Q4 pulls SD_MODE low.

g.text: Internal body diodes: S1(CELL_NEG) -> common D <- S2(PROT_FET_RETURN).

g.desc: Internal body diodes: S1(CELL_NEG) -> common D <- S2(PROT_FET_RETURN).

g.text: USB / return / mux / cell / switched input

g.desc: USB / return / mux / cell / switched input

g.text: NO LIVE CELL: reverse insertion, cell-temperature charging and charge-profile gates OPEN.

g.desc: NO LIVE CELL: reverse insertion, cell-temperature charging and charge-profile gates OPEN.

g.text: R8 stays 5.1k (~196mA; AC termination~14.7mA). NOT a complete BMS or safety approval.

g.desc: R8 stays 5.1k (~196mA; AC termination~14.7mA). NOT a complete BMS or safety approval.

g.text: No second regulator or level shifter.

g.desc: No second regulator or level shifter.

g.text: Bus rise time remains a layout check.

g.desc: Bus rise time remains a layout check.

g.text: 0.2 ELECTRICAL / PLACEMENT DRAFT - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: 0.2 ELECTRICAL / PLACEMENT DRAFT - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: Cell, charge/temperature/cutoff policy and exact power MPNs unresolved.

g.desc: Cell, charge/temperature/cutoff policy and exact power MPNs unresolved.

g.text: BTL speaker outputs: neither lead is ground. No hardware qualification.

g.desc: BTL speaker outputs: neither lead is ground. No hardware qualification.

g.text: BQ29700 + common-drain dual N-FET + 33mR series sense: all charge/load return crosses cutoff.

g.desc: BQ29700 + common-drain dual N-FET + 33mR series sense: all charge/load return crosses cutoff.

g.text: No parallel JST battery inlet. BT1/BT2 are identical Keystone254revC SMT contacts.

g.desc: No parallel JST battery inlet. BT1/BT2 are identical Keystone254revC SMT contacts.

g.text: SERVICE PADS: no fitted headers; route to accessible edge/fixture.

g.desc: SERVICE PADS: no fitted headers; route to accessible edge/fixture.

g.text: SPEAKER: isolated BTL pair, 4 ohm target

g.desc: SPEAKER: isolated BTL pair, 4 ohm target

g.text: Molex Pico-Lock, not battery JST-PH or button JST-SH.

g.desc: Molex Pico-Lock, not battery JST-PH or button JST-SH.

g.text: T8 LOW-SIDE PROTECTION: raw CELL_NEG is NOT board/USB GND

g.desc: T8 LOW-SIDE PROTECTION: raw CELL_NEG is NOT board/USB GND

g.text: Drive mute HIGH before enabling POWER.

g.desc: Drive mute HIGH before enabling POWER.

g.text: Supply collapse/pop behavior remains a bench gate.

g.desc: Supply collapse/pop behavior remains a bench gate.

g.text: DOUT drives G1: blocks discharge return. COUT drives G2: blocks charge return.

g.desc: DOUT drives G1: blocks discharge return. COUT drives G2: blocks charge return.

g.text: Firmware debounce + final cable/ESD review required.

g.desc: Firmware debounce + final cable/ESD review required.

g.text: EN follows GPIO23 POWER; existing R17 supplies default pulldown.

g.desc: EN follows GPIO23 POWER; existing R17 supplies default pulldown.

g.text: R1 default-on pull-up omitted. Input remains behind Q1/Q2.

g.desc: R1 default-on pull-up omitted. Input remains behind Q1/Q2.

g.text: Power MPNs / effective capacitance not frozen.

g.desc: Power MPNs / effective capacitance not frozen.

g.text: C29: optional feed-forward; resolve for >40uF effective Cout.

g.desc: C29: optional feed-forward; resolve for >40uF effective Cout.
